messages:
Sam Carter: Quick FYI — kicking off a short migration sprint to move /platform/* into /runtime/platform. This will be split across 4 PRs to avoid huge previews. Need reviewer assignments and a merge order that avoids redirect churn.
Tara Nguyen: +1. can you post the PR list and which anchors are delicate?
Sam Carter: PRs: #4212 (intro + redirects), #4214 (runtime API move), #4216 (examples & snippets), #4218 (links + permalinks). The tricky anchors are in runtime/api.md and the SDK snippets in examples/embedding.md — a few anchors are referenced by external blog posts.
Miguel Santos: For merge order I suggest: #4212 -> #4214 -> #4216 -> #4218. Intro creates redirects first. Also add a short TTL on the preview CDN so we can validate redirects.
Oliver Park: CI/docs-preview flagged a broken anchor in #4214 when I ran the preview locally. Error: 404 anchor not found in runtime/api.md -> anchor `--kv-cache-ops`. logs:
```
Error: Broken anchor: runtime/api.md#--kv-cache-ops referenced from examples/embedding.md: line 83
Preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4214
```
Lisa Chen: Ok that's the one I mentioned. We should not merge #4214 until #4216 fixes the snippet references OR we update the example anchors to the new names. Which do you prefer?
Sam Carter: Prefer updating examples in #4216 and keep #4214 focused on path moves + redirects. But that means #4216 needs reviewer bandwidth before #4214 merges.
Tara Nguyen: I can review #4216 tomorrow morning. Assign me as reviewer. Also pinging @Miguel for quick anchor validation after changes. :eyes:
Miguel Santos: assigned and will smoke test after Tara's pass. I can also run the link-checker script with the --follow-redirects flag.
docs-bot: docs-preview build started for PR #4212 — status: pending.
deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/4212 — ready for smoke test.
Oliver Park: Quick note on redirects: add this mapping to _redirects.yml in #4212 so external permalinks keep working: 
```
- from: "/platform/api/*"
  to: "/runtime/platform/api/:splat"
  status: 302
  preserve_query: true
```
Sam Carter: Good. Also add a comment header listing the dependent PRs and the intended merge window in the PR description — helps reviewers.
Lisa Chen: One more edge case — product team owns a doc that links to /platform/sdk/python#auth. We should add a manual redirect for that specific anchor until external links age out. I'll add a short-lived redirect rule in #4212 and annotate it with expiration date.
Tara Nguyen: About merge timing: let's do a canary merge window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT. Merge #4212 first, wait 20 mins for previews + CDN invalidation, then #4214 if no anchor errors, otherwise hold.
Miguel Santos: I'll run link-checker on the live preview and post results here. If any 4xx on anchors show up, revert plan and block #4214.
Oliver Park: If we detect anchor drift, fallback plan: rollback #4212 and open a quick follow-up PR to add temporary anchor aliases in new files.
Sam Carter: Sounds good. I added a checklist to the umbrella issue with reviewers, merge times, and rollback plan. Will update PR descriptions now.
Tara Nguyen: Thanks — tagging legal for the rare case external docs need notice: @legal-team (just in case).
docs-bot: docs-preview build succeeded for PR #4212 — status: success.
deploy-bot: CDN invalidation kicked for preview 4212, ETA ~15m.
Miguel Santos: Link-checker run: no 4xx for top-level pages, but 1 broken anchor remaining: examples/embedding.md -> runtime/api.md#--kv-cache-ops. I'm starting a tiny patch branch to add an alias anchor in runtime/api.md and referencing it in #4216.
Lisa Chen: Perfect. Once #4216 lands with alias, we can merge #4214. Then #4218 to clean up old anchors and remove temporary redirect.
Sam Carter: Final ask — please leave short review notes in each PR about expected post-merge checks (smoke URL, link-check, search indexing). I'll coordinate rollback if anything odd pops up.
Tara Nguyen: Will do. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
